//: Production posture for the Web host. Base appsettings.json keeps RequireDatabase=false for the standalone Development run (no DB); production must NOT silently fall back to no-op repositories — a missing connection string should fail loudly rather than lose data. Offline LLM fallback is already off outside Development (code default) and is locked off below.

Settings.//: ADR-0011 operator locks: production pins the riskiest platform switches so the Settings UI cannot flip them. To change one, set the env var (e.g. Settings__Locks__RemoteAgent__AutoApprove=true) — a deliberate deployment decision, not a click.
